Episode 185. The Remaining People (6)
The next day, in the former capital of the Vermont Empire.
In the square, declarations of honor for the fallen had been going on for quite some time.
Reading the names of the deceased and mourning them had already taken several hours.
However, under the scorching sun without any shade, not a single person among those gathered in the square had left their spot.
Many were silently shedding tears.

Some were crying thinking of those who were slaughtered by the monster, some cried for those who died in battle, and some cried out of overwhelming gratitude for the fact that they could continue to live.
"... With this, we conclude the memorial service."
Behind Jin, flags symbolizing each faction and family were raised.
Jin turned around for the last time and paid his respects to the flags for a long time.
Now it was time to make the announcement.
"From today, the temporary alliance of the Vamel Union, Zipple, and Kinselro, which resisted the monster, has officially been dissolved. Now each faction will return to its original relationship."
Everyone knew that a new storm was brewing.

"Before the final battle with the monster, Runcandel, Zipple, and Kinselro agreed to one thing. After the war ends, for at least one year, they will not attack each other - a limited non-aggression pact. I swear here today, Runcandel will never be the first to break this pact."
Ronil and Zephrin behind him had no choice but to mull over Jin's words.
'Why would Jin announce in a place like this that he will not break the pact? Is he trying to test us?'
'I doubt Jin would show his weakness. Rather than a trick to justify a war, it seems more like a warning or threat....'
The possibility of summoning Tushin Vahn and Murakan was the biggest concern for Zipple and Kinselro at the moment.
Until they figured that out, the two factions wouldn't dare threaten Runcandel.
On the other hand, Jin didn't need to be as wary as them.
"In addition, Runcandel intends to make public all records related to the war against the monster. With the help of the record magician, Valeria Hister."
At his words, the dignitaries of Zipple, including Ronil, barely managed to hide their surprise.
The square buzzed at the words 'record magician' and 'Hister'.
Both those who knew and those who did not know the name and its significance were showing interest.
"Magician Valeria Hister participated in this war as part of the Vamel Union, and has organized almost all the records of the war. Valeria."
At Jin's call, Valeria, who had been hooded in the crowd, stepped up to the podium.
As she removed her hood, her red hair and undecorated bare face were revealed.
"My name is Valeria Hister. As the last survivor of the Hister family, I am capable of using record magic, as you can see."
Woooong…!
When Valeria shook her silver birch wand, a huge record window floated up next to the podium.
Closely packed, records of the war against the monster were described.
"Is that magic?"
"I've heard of it. There used to be families who could use such magic, up until a few hundred years ago…"
The crowd's gaze was focused on the record window.
Naturally, Zipple had expected Jin to thoroughly hide information about Valeria in the future. Information tends to become more valuable when it's monopolized.
Above all, Zipple thought there would be no benefit for Jin to reveal Valeria to the public.
However, Jin thought differently.
'When I was powerless, I had to hide no matter what, but now I don't need to. Judging by their startled looks, it seems they didn't expect this at all.'
Despite being terrified by the power of Jin they had seen in the monster war, Zipple was still partially stuck in their old stubbornness.
They still had the notion that Jin must be hiding something from them.

"Being the only survivor of the Hister family, I cannot maintain this record window indefinitely. The record will be open for a week from today. That should be enough time for this content to be transcribed and known worldwide."
"Lord Jin, and Miss Valeria Hister! What is the reason for suddenly revealing the existence of a record magician?"
A reporter asked. Of course, he was a reporter from Dino Jaglun, and the question had been prearranged.
"I believe that all information should be transparently shared because it was a war where the whole world combined its strength."
"Did you agree on this with the families who were part of the temporary alliance?"

"Not really. Is it a matter that really needs agreement? I think it's an obvious disclosure. That's all, I will take questions from the reporters after the announcement. Valeria, continue your explanation."

"Yes, Lord. In addition, Runcandel and the Vamel Union have decided to share all the value that can be obtained through record magic with the world. For example, societal development through the discovery of lost practical skills, restoration of lost history, international crime tracking, etc."
Over the past thousands of years, it was clear that Zipple had been leading the 'development' of the world.
Even the magic lights found in every household were all developed by Zipple.
It was no exaggeration to say that all essential items involving the word 'magic' came from Zipple.
But if what Valeria said was true, then Runcandel and the Vamel Union might be taking over Zipple's place now.
"Is that really possible?"
Even if they weren't reporters, someone might have asked such a question, but the crowd did not voice any doubts.
Because Jin Runcandel, the Lord of the Sword Clan, was asserting it.
The weight of the honor that Jin had built up over time was shining.

"However, as I mentioned, I am the last magician of the Hister family. Because I have only one body, there is a limit to what I can do. Also, until the monster war, I was being tracked by one group for a long time, so the restoration of the family's magic inevitably took quite a long time."
Was the expression 'one group' a last consideration?
The moment Ronil was sweating and thinking so, Valeria coolly stated the name.
"That group is Zipple."
This time, the crowd's gaze was focused on Zipple's representatives.

"There is a long and dark history between our Hister family and Zipple, a history I can't fully explain to you all. But if I may appeal to the Zipple family as a comrade who fought alongside the monster for a while, I would like them to finally let me go. If Zipple gives up their obsession with Hister, I will also forget the past."
Of course, she was not sincere.
Even if Zipple truly gives up on Hister, Valeria's grudge against them will not fade in the slightest.
It was just a word spat out to defame the name Zipple. Because Zipple would never be able to accept that statement.
If they reject it, they become garbage, and if they accept it, they make a promise they can't keep in front of the public.
In the end, Ronil sighed and chose the former.
"I can't accept Miss Valeria's proposal. It doesn't seem like the right place to discuss such a sensitive matter. However, I wish you good luck."
Jin thought to himself at Ronil's response.

'If it had been Veradin, he would have asked whether Valeria's claim to forget the past was true and had her prove it with record magic right now. If he had done that, we would have been the ones caught off guard. Poor move, Ronil Zipple.'
Valeria nodded her head.

"I understand. As Lord Jin said, it's not the right place. I just announced the position of the Runcandel and Vamel Union regarding me to Zipple's side. Anyway, if you felt disrespected, I apologize."
With such provocative words, it wasn't easy for Zipple and Kinzelo to grasp the situation.
They couldn't help but be confused about whether Jin could fully use the power he showed during the monster war.
'He said he would respect the inviolability agreement and then makes this provocation, it seems like he is confident, no matter how you look at it.'
'...It's a good thing we didn't bring Lord Kadun. His voice would have been too loud.'
Valeria stepped back behind Jin.

"Although we have just shown a rather unfavorable situation, rest assured that we plan to continue to jointly purify the contaminated area left by Gliak as part of the previous temporary alliance. This concludes the Runcandel statement. Lastly, I would like to express my gratitude to everyone present and all the comrades of the Monster War who could not attend. I will now step back."
Jin bowed to the crowd.
This too, was a sight never seen in the old Runcandel.
Therefore, people felt that the current Runcandel appeared more humble than ever.
And yet, they also felt more powerful than ever.
As Jin stepped down from the podium, applause and cheers followed, and the reporters chased after Jin and Valeria.
While the reporters and crowds were focused on Valeria, Jin was quietly leaving the capital.
His destination was the official capital of the empire.
It was the old Sword Emperor Castle, which now bore the name "Sword Emperor Land".
Dante moved the capital here as soon as he became the regent, but that was just a symbolic change to honor Ron.
Sword Emperor Land was a land where people or animals couldn't even live, let alone move administrative facilities, due to the confusion caused by spirits.
Surely, that's all the saints knew.
"Dante."
At Jin's voice, Dante turned around and smiled.
In front of Dante was a lump of light left by Ron, and the words engraved by the two with a sword in the past.
Sword Emperor Ron Hairan. Here, Hairan became the light, or the light of the world.
"Did you arrive? Jin."
Jin took the glass of alcohol Dante handed over, carefully placed it in front of Ron's light, and offered a silent prayer.
The two meeting here today wasn't just to honor Ron.
"The land is being purified much faster than we thought."
"It's thanks to my grandfather's consideration for me."
Sword Emperor Land, known to have the largest chaos left by Gliak, was in fact already sufficiently transformed for people to operate.
Only Jin and Dante knew this fact.
From the outside, Sword Emperor Land still seemed to be wrapped in a horribly huge chaos.
"It must have been a tough decision, are you sure it's okay?"
"It wasn't that hard. As soon as I confirmed that the land was being purified quickly, I was ready to make a decision. My grandfather would have wanted this."
Dante's decision was nothing else.
The decision to use the purified Sword Emperor Land as the secret shipyard of the Vamel Alliance.
